implemented: v6 fail-closed forecast ledger with Ed25519 attestation
verified_gaps: walk_forward.py calls bootstrap defaults of 1,000 replicates, 30 origins and 95% confidence; v6 ledger requires 10,000 replicates, 100 paired origins and 99.375% individual confidence for eight Bonferroni comparisons.
Current walk-forward bootstrap uses naive_class_prior as the single benchmark; candidate-versus-each-of-four-baselines OOS and shadow comparisons are not yet verified.
Source clusters require one canonical independence group per target record; multi-publisher composites remain unclustered.
Circular row-index blocks are sorted by timestamp but do not enforce cadence or maximum elapsed-time gaps; missing-origin gaps can be bridged.
No trained XRP-specific candidate model, mature synchronized historical data, independent WORM/time anchoring or independent shadow cohort.
